page.overview:
Who is Salamander?

King Lizard † (leader) Supreme Lizard † (leader) Iguana † Komodo Dragon † Gila Monster (M.I.A) Gecko (M.I.A)

Salamander was a supervillain and member of the Lizard League.

At some point in his life, Salamander would gain his abilities and join the Lizard League.

Salamander hijacks a facility, following the commands of his leader Queen Lizard. He along with the other members, are ordered to search the facility for a serum. Their hijacking would be rudely interrupted by The Immortal, War Woman, Aquarus, Black Samson, and Green Ghost I. His comrades would fight the heroes, causing them to struggle a bit until the arrival of Omni-Man. After his arrival, they were quickly defeated as their plans were thwarted.
